title: Sperm Concentration Halved—and Total Counts Fell Further
hook: The decline did not stop at thinner samples; the pace accelerated.
closing: Faster declines in both measures make male fertility a growing public-health concern.
question: Should fertility tracking start earlier?

segments.say: Average sperm concentration fell to 49 million per milliliter. That left it below half its earlier level.
The annual sperm decline reached 2.64 percent. The loss was accelerating, not merely continuing.
Total sperm count fell 62 percent. The broader measure dropped even further than concentration.
